name: Waterworks

features.text: Server-authoritative measured fluid transfer, multi-axis quality, treatment, bounded persistent networks, routing, scheduling, maintenance and thermal transactions.
Craftable sediment batch housing and replaceable sand/cloth cartridges; server-owned capacity/generation, explicit connected-container filtering, conservative recovery and four sandbox options.
Generic provider APIs, filter chains, foreign-plumbing conformance and exact drain reservations support consumers; native integration evidence remains limited.
Additional filter media, automatic inline filtration, measured balance and authenticated administration/migration workflows.
Dedicated G7 and stable-release G8 await native two-client persistence, synchronization and restart evidence.

limits: Offline Lua 5.1: 54 PASS with pinned Power; 48 PASS / 6 optional skips standalone. Native crafting, SP and dedicated MP NOT TESTED. Pending housing recovery has no automatic reset/resolution.

relations.text: Powered pumps, purifier and heating consume current B47ANCEDPower API with legacy powerWorks fallback; sediment housing requires no power. Offline integration only.
